name: toast
pattern: A toast using WAI-ARIA Status Messages and a consumer-provided live region
responsibility: Provides visibility, ARIA, dismissal, timers, and state outputs for an existing live region. Does not create the toast element or notification content.

authorMarkup.root: A consumer-provided HTMLElement with data-controller="toast"; the root is both the live region and toast content.
authorMarkup.dismiss: An optional native <button type="button"> with data-toast-target="dismiss"; consumers supply its wording and accessible name.
authorMarkup.content: The controller creates no toast element, live region, notification text, or buttons.
authorMarkup.position: Consumer CSS and markup determine placement, stacking, z-index, and queuing.

root: The root must be an HTMLElement
Zero or one dismiss target is allowed.
The dismiss target must be a native <button type="button"> inside the root.
values: duration must be a finite number >= 0.
live must be polite or assertive.
contractValidation.popover: A root with a popover attribute must support showPopover()/hidePopover().
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Invalid configuration warns once per connection and disables ARIA, listeners, timers, state outputs, and visibility operations. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Warnings identify toast controller and invalid markup/values.
contractValidation.completionExempt: Role and aria-live reflect the live configuration and are not subject to completion warnings.

duration.description: Milliseconds from becoming visible until automatic hiding; zero disables automatic hiding.

live.description: Value supplied when root aria-live is absent. Preserve authored aria-live.

visible.description: Current visibility. Assignment synchronizes visibility/data-state without events.

show().description: Show programmatically without moving focus or emitting custom events. Only a trusted Event supplied through a Stimulus action uses the user-originated show event path.

hide().description: Hide programmatically without moving focus or emitting custom events. Only a trusted dismiss-button or Stimulus-action Event uses the user-originated hide event path.

toast:beforeshow.when: Before a show action receiving a trusted user Event changes hidden to visible
toast:beforeshow.effect: preventDefault() leaves visibility/timer unchanged and suppresses toast:show.

toast:show.when: After the user show action commits without toast:beforeshow cancellation

toast:beforehide.when: Before a trusted dismiss-button or user hide action changes visible to hidden
toast:beforehide.effect: preventDefault() prevents hiding, leaves the timer unchanged, and suppresses toast:hide.

toast:hide.when: After the user hide action commits without toast:beforehide cancellation

events.programmatic: visible assignment, show(), hide(), initialization, reconnection, timeout, external popover toggle, and disconnect emit no custom events. Timeout does not emit an event with reason=timeout.
events.sameState: User operations requesting the current visibility emit no before/after events.

managedMarkup.role: Supply role=status for live=polite or role=alert for live=assertive only when root role is absent. Preserve authored role.
managedMarkup.ariaLive: Supply the live value as aria-live only when absent. Preserve authored aria-live.
managedMarkup.popover: Respect authored popover. In popover mode, use Popover API visibility rather than changing hidden for visibility state.
managedMarkup.hidden: Synchronize hidden for visibility only without popover.
managedMarkup.stateOnly: The sole controller-managed CSS hook is root data-state="visible" or "hidden".
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored id, role, aria-live, aria-atomic, popover, hidden, and other attributes except required state outputs.

behavior.initial: Initial visibility comes from hidden when not a popover, or :popover-open when it is.
behavior.show: show() does not move focus and starts a timeout after becoming visible when duration > 0.
behavior.hide: hide() does not move focus and cancels the timer.
behavior.dismiss: Trusted clicks on enabled dismiss buttons use pointer for click.detail>0 or keyboard for detail=0, then close through beforehide.
behavior.timing: duration=0 disables automatic hiding. Do not hide on the duration timer while focus is inside the root; restart the full duration when focus leaves. Measurements in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit show hiding a root containing focus drops focus to body in both hidden/popover modes. Consumers decide how to make automatically hidden information available elsewhere.
behavior.focus: Never move focus or add the toast root to the tab sequence. Timers do not move focus because automatic hiding is postponed while focus remains inside.

lifecycle: Register listeners in connect() and remove them in disconnect(); do not duplicate them during Turbo reconnection.
Cancel/reschedule timers as needed on connect(), show(), hide(), disconnect(), and focus entering/leaving the root.
Target/value callbacks do not change visibility before connect(); coalesce reconciliation during connection.
Do not remove generated role, aria-live, data-state, or hidden on disconnect().

observations.environment: Screen readers on real devices and browser focus behavior
observations.item: Live-region announcement order, pre-existing regions, repeated notifications, Popover interaction, and timer resumption when a focused element disappears without focusout
observations.impact: Consumer-authored live regions and the no-timer-focus rule are fixed. Failure to resume the timer leaves the toast visible and preserves its information; this outcome is not reported as verified.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
Conforming consumer-provided live regions must support WCAG 2.2 Level AA Status Messages (4.1.3), announcing state without moving focus.

Automated tests cannot fully verify implicit live behavior of status/alert/log roles, Popover focus/stacking, pre-existing live regions, or repeated announcements. Report real-device screen reader verification as unverified.

If a focused element disappears without focusout, such as removing a focused dismiss button, timer resumption remains unverified. Failure to resume leaves the toast visible, preserving the information.
Only trusted user actions emit one cancelable before event and one committed event, in order.
Programmatic API calls, initialization, timeout, and external popover toggles synchronize state without events.
duration=0 does not auto-hide; duration>0 timers are canceled on disconnect.
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device screen reader checks of announcement order, pre-existing regions, repeated notifications, and Popover behavior as unverified.

testMatrix.description: Synchronizing role, aria-live, data-state, and authored attributes
Initial hidden state and visible/hide API synchronization
Dismiss beforehide cancellation, hide event, and pointer/keyboard reason
No events from visible assignment, show/hide API, or synthetic operations
Duration timeout, duration=0, and timer cleanup on disconnect
Pause timers while focus is inside, then restart duration and auto-hide after focus leaves
Warnings and disabled enhancement for invalid dismiss targets or values

mutation.description: Disable semantic/value validation and accept invalid toast configuration.
Disable timer cleanup on disconnect, allowing stale timeouts after reconnection.
Fix root data-state to a constant, losing visible/hidden synchronization.
Remove the role hasAttribute guard and overwrite authored role.
Remove the aria-live hasAttribute guard and overwrite authored aria-live.
Fix hidden synchronization to a constant on non-popover roots, breaking visibility after hide.
Remove the dismiss disabled guard and accept disabled activation.
Remove dismiss-click isTrusted checking and treat synthetic clicks as user operations.
Remove the duration > 0 timer condition and schedule timeouts for duration=0.

negativeControls.expectedFailure: toast-timer-schedule-negative, toast-state-sync, toast-dismiss-events, and toast-popover-mode fail on the shared timer/state invariant.

mutation.description: Disable reconciliation after duration changes, losing dynamic timer configuration.
Disable timer cancellation on focusin, allowing automatic hiding while focus is inside.
Disable scheduleTimer's focus guard and schedule timers while focus is inside.
Disable the external Popover toggle listener so external visibility changes do not update state.
Remove both listener cleanup and connected reset on disconnect, allowing listeners to act afterward.
Remove the one-dismiss-target limit and accept multiple buttons.
